Name: Bilingual Dialogue for Android
Author: ArashiDll
Description:
Bilingual Dialogue for Android adds a small [b]A[/b] button to NPC dialogue boxes. Tap it to switch the current dialogue line to another official Stardew Valley language.

The mod does [b]not[/b] use machine translation or any external translation service. It reads the matching official text already included with the game, using the same dialogue key in your selected target language.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Adds a compact [b]A[/b] button to NPC dialogue boxes [/*]
[*]Switches the current dialogue line to a target language selected in Generic Mod Config Menu [/*]
[*]Uses only official Stardew Valley localized text [/*]
[*]Supports the game's official languages, including English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Turkish, Hungarian, and Italian [/*]
[*]Configurable button position and touch area [/*]
[*]Android-friendly touch input handling [/*]
[*]No Harmony patching [/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Android 1.6.15.0[/*]
[*]SMAPI Android [/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu [/*]
[/list][heading]How to Use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install the mod and Generic Mod Config Menu. [/*]
[*]Open Generic Mod Config Menu and choose your target dialogue language. [/*]
[*]Talk to an NPC. [/*]
[*]Tap the [b]A[/b] button in the dialogue box. [/*]
[*]If matching official text is available, the current dialogue line will switch to the selected language. [/*]
[/list][heading]Configuration[/heading]
With Generic Mod Config Menu, you can change:
[list]
[*]Target dialogue language [/*]
[*]Whether to use a custom button position [/*]
[*]Button X position [/*]
[*]Button Y position [/*]
[*]Button touch padding [/*]
[/list][heading]Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]This mod is built for Android SMAPI and touch input. [/*]
[*]It is intended for official Stardew Valley dialogue text. [/*]
[*]Modded dialogue may work if it uses compatible translation keys and localized assets. [/*]
[*]If a line has no matching official text in the target language, the dialogue will stay unchanged. [/*]
[*]If the button position does not fit your screen, adjust it in Generic Mod Config Menu. [/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
Built and tested for Stardew Valley Android 1.6.15.0 with SMAPI Android.
[heading]Credits[/heading]
Created as a small Android-focused QoL mod for players who want to compare or read NPC dialogue in another official Stardew Valley language.
